verdict.rationale: cubic runs event-triggered agents: it reviews every new PR automatically, codebase scans deploy agents to find bugs, and the AI wiki stays current through a rolling PR. However, fixes happen only when a human clicks 'Fix with cubic' or comments, so it does not autonomously maintain or fix software on its own. Missing for 10: scheduled or cron-based agent runs, autonomous fixing without a human trigger, and user-defined triggers beyond PR events and comments.
